title: Add 'JB News & Updates' Widget to Homepage with Curated RSS Feed Integration
description: Implement a live news widget on the homepage fetching from 4-5 curated RSS sources (Tourism JB, Malaysia News, local events). Display 5 latest items with title, publish date, source attribution, and read-more link. Cache results for 6 hours to minimize feed requests.
acceptanceCriteria: Widget fetches and displays 5 latest news items from app/config/rss-sources.ts with title, date, source, and clickable link
Failed RSS feed endpoints gracefully degrade to cached results or placeholder state without breaking layout
Server-side cache refreshes every 6 hours; manual refresh endpoint available at GET /api/news/refresh
technicalNotes: File to create: app/components/JBNewsWidget.tsx (RSS parsing, <Feed> UI component)
File to create: app/config/rss-sources.ts (array of RSS URLs with source metadata)
File to create: app/lib/rss-parser.ts (fetch + parse feed with error handling + caching via React cache())
File to modify: app/page.tsx (import and render JBNewsWidget on homepage)
Test command: vitest run app/lib/rss-parser.test.ts (mock feed parsing, verify cache logic)

title: Build Hostel Amenity Comparison Matrix with LocationFeatureSpecification Schema
description: Create an interactive comparison table displaying 6-8 JB hostels across 12 key amenities (WiFi, kitchen, lockers, AC, laundry, social areas, etc.). Each amenity row embeds LocationFeatureSpecification JSON-LD. Table is sortable/filterable by hostel or amenity with highlighting.
acceptanceCriteria: Table renders 6-8 hostels (columns) × 12 amenities (rows) with checkmark icons; each hostel column links to hostel website
Each <tr> data attribute contains LocationFeatureSpecification JSON for the amenity; schema validation passes via AJV
Filter UI allows toggle by hostel name or amenity type; table dynamically hides/shows columns; Playwright test confirms filter interactions
technicalNotes: File to create: data/jb-hostels-amenities.ts (array of hostel objects with amenity flags and external links)
File to create: app/components/HostelAmenityMatrix.tsx (table component with filter state, LocationFeatureSpecification schema embedding)
File to modify: app/lib/schema-generators.ts (addLocationFeatureSpecification function for amenity row schema)
Test command: vitest run app/components/HostelAmenityMatrix.test.ts (filter logic, schema structure)

title: Create Interactive JB Backpacker Daily Budget Calculator Tool
description: Build a client-side budget calculator allowing backpackers to input daily spend on accommodation, meals, activities, and local transport. Displays daily total, 7-day projection, and cost breakdown by category. Embeds WebApplication or SoftwareApplication schema for discoverability.
acceptanceCriteria: Calculator renders 4 input fields (accommodation RM/night, meals RM/day, activities RM/day, transport RM/day) with default values; live displays daily total and 7-day projection
Breakdown pie chart updates reactively; localStorage persists user inputs across sessions
SoftwareApplication JSON-LD embedded in page head with applicationCategory='Travel/Budget', includes name, description, url
technicalNotes: File to create: app/components/BudgetCalculator.tsx (React form with useReducer state, recharts pie chart, localStorage sync)
File to create: app/(website)/budget-calculator/page.tsx (page wrapper with SEO metadata)
File to create: lib/schema-generators.ts (getSoftwareApplicationSchema function with calculator metadata)
Test command: vitest run app/components/BudgetCalculator.test.ts (input handling, calculation accuracy, localStorage)

title: Implement Related Blog Posts Widget with IsSimilarTo Schema Linking
description: Add a 'You Might Also Like' widget on blog article pages displaying 3 most-relevant related posts. Relevance determined by shared tags and categories. Each related post card embeds IsSimilarTo JSON-LD linking back to the current article for bidirectional SEO.
acceptanceCriteria: RelatedPosts component queries blog index, filters by matching tags/categories, ranks by match count, returns top 3; cards show post title, excerpt, publish date
Each related post <a> includes data-relationship='similar' and embeds IsSimilarTo JSON-LD in parent schema
Playwright test confirms widget displays on 3 sample blog post pages and schema validation passes
technicalNotes: File to create: app/components/RelatedPosts.tsx (BlogPost[] filter by tags, sort by match count, render cards with schema)
File to create: lib/blog-search.ts (function searchRelatedPosts(currentPostTags, currentPostCategories) returning sorted BlogPost[])
File to modify: app/(website)/blog/[slug]/page.tsx (import and render <RelatedPosts /> above comments section)
Test command: vitest run lib/blog-search.test.ts (search relevance ranking, tie-breaking logic)

title: Create JB Events Calendar Page with Event Schema for Festivals & Markets
description: Build a /events page displaying annual JB events (food festivals, night markets, parades, holidays) with dates, location, brief description. Filterable by month and category. Each event embeds Event JSON-LD schema with name, startDate, location, description for Google rich results.
acceptanceCriteria: Page renders 15+ JB events in a calendar/list view; month filter (Jan-Dec) and category tabs (food, culture, market) dynamically show/hide events
Each event card includes title, date range, location, category badge; embeds Event schema with startDate (ISO 8601), location object, and url
SEO: page title contains 'JB Events' and meta description covers festivals; schema validation via Lighthouse Structured Data audit passes
technicalNotes: File to create: data/jb-events.ts (array of Event objects with name, startDate, endDate, location, category, description)
File to create: app/(website)/events/page.tsx (calendar/list view with filter state, Event schema embedding, generateMetadata)
File to create: app/components/EventCard.tsx (event display card component with Event JSON-LD in parent)
Test command: vitest run data/jb-events.test.ts (date validation, category filtering logic)
